d:
Tight hips, shallow breathing, and stress held in the body can keep your nervous system stuck in “on” mode long after the day ends. These two simple poses help slow the breath, release accumulated tension, and make it easier to settle into deep, restorative sleep.
You do not need a long nighttime routine to feel a difference. A few intentional minutes can change the way your body meets rest. The body often carries the momentum of the day until we give it a reason to let go.
